svg.aria-label: armada: you send a job from the CLI, the TypeScript SDK or armada run; a Worker in your Cloudflare account queues its items; an environment built once from your recipe is snapshotted; containers start from the snapshot and pull tasks until the queue is empty; results stream back, with outputs and logs in R2.
